set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Comparisons share data, seeds, threads, stopping criteria, and answer-quality thresholds.
- Solver-only and end-to-end time plus peak memory are separated.
- Environment, versions, commit, compiler flags, hardware, warmup, and repetitions are recorded.
- Invalid-quality runs cannot count as benchmarks.
- One entry point generates current baselines; scratch history is excluded or archived.
set.title: Define a canonical correctness-controlled benchmark protocol
